headline: Prime angle wasted under building SW cross-on — not worth the drive.
today: Swell's on a good angle and there's size on the sets, but the SW cross-on builds to 14mph through the day and never lets up. Dawn is the only semi-clean look and it's marginal. Skip the 2.5hr for this one.

daysToWatch.note: NW offshore at dawn with a small clean SSW — fun quick session if you're already out there, not a destination day.
Blown out — 19mph ESE cross-on early sitting on a fair-angle swell.
